summary: Batch homogeneous-weight scaling: processes exactly 16 consecutive float4 (X,Y,Z,W) vectors, reading each from the source pointer and writing to the destination pointer. For each vector it multiplies X, Y and Z by that vector's own W and passes W through unchanged. A pre-transform vertex/point weighting step.

local_names.v3: intermediate product W * X for the current vector

operations.description: Iterate exactly 16 times (v2 initialized to 16, decremented each pass), advancing both the source and destination pointers by 4 floats per iteration until the counter reaches zero
Compute v3 = a1[3] * a1[0], i.e. multiply the W component (this+0xC) by the X component (this+0x0) of the current source vector
Write the product v3 into the destination X slot (*a2 = v3), then advance both pointers by 4 floats
Write the remaining components of the current vector: destination Y = source Y * source W, destination Z = source Z * source W, destination W = source W (unchanged pass-through)
Return 0 once all 16 vectors have been scaled; reached from DelegationWithErrorCheck (005158AF) and InitProcessWrapper (005158E3)
